meaning: غذا و نوشیدنی فراهم کردن (برای مراسم)

examples.english: The restaurant can cater for 100 people.
examples.persian: این رستوران می‌تواند برای ۱۰۰ نفر غذا تهیه کند.

miniContext: Cater for sth/sb means to provide food and drinks for a social event.

examples.english: The company agreed to compensate him for his loss.
examples.persian: شرکت موافقت کرد خسارتش را جبران کند.

miniContext: Compensate sb for sth means to provide sth good to balance or reduce the bad effects of damage, loss, etc.

examples.english: You can substitute water for milk in this recipe.
examples.persian: در این دستور پخت می‌توانی آب را جایگزین شیر کنی.

miniContext: Substitute sth for sth/sb means to use sth/sb instead of sth/sb else.

examples.english: My opinion differs from his.
examples.persian: نظر من با نظر او فرق دارد.

miniContext: Differ from sth/sb means to be different from sth/sb.

meaning: تشخیص دادن تفاوت بین دو چیز

examples.english: I can't distinguish one twin from the other.
examples.persian: نمی‌توانم این دو دوقلو را از هم تشخیص دهم.

miniContext: Distinguish sth from sth means to recognize the difference between two people or things.

examples.english: She distracted me from working.
examples.persian: او حواسم را از کار کردن پرت کرد.

miniContext: Distract sb from sth means to take sb's attention away from what they are trying to do.

examples.english: I want to exclude fat from my diet.
examples.persian: می‌خواهم چربی را از رژیم غذایی‌ام حذف کنم.

miniContext: Exclude sth from sth means to deliberately not include sth in what you are doing.

examples.english: I congratulated him on his result.
examples.persian: بابت نتیجه‌اش به او تبریک گفتم.

miniContext: Congratulate sb on sth means to tell sb you are pleased about their success.

examples.english: She's about to embark on a new career.
examples.persian: او در آستانه‌ی شروع یک شغل جدید است.

miniContext: Embark on sth means to start to do sth new or difficult.

examples.english: She insisted on going with me.
examples.persian: او اصرار داشت با من بیاید.

miniContext: Insist on sth means to demand that sth happens or that sb does something.

examples.english: They accused him of lying.
examples.persian: او را متهم به دروغگویی کردند.

miniContext: Accuse sb of sth means to say that sb has done sth wrong or is guilty of sth.

examples.english: They deprived the animals of food for days.
examples.persian: چند روز حیوانات را از غذا محروم کردند.

miniContext: Deprive sb/sth of sth means to prevent sb from having or doing sth, especially sth important.

meaning: دور انداختن، خلاص شدن از چیزی

examples.english: We need to dispose of this old furniture.
examples.persian: باید از شر این مبلمان قدیمی خلاص شویم.

miniContext: Dispose of sth means to get rid of sth that you do not want or cannot keep.

examples.english: We must adhere to the rules.
examples.persian: باید به قوانین پایبند باشیم.

miniContext: Adhere to sth means to behave according to a particular law, rule, set of instructions, etc.

examples.english: I had to cling to the side of the boat.
examples.persian: مجبور شدم محکم به کنار قایق بچسبم.

miniContext: Cling to sth/sb means to hold on tightly to sth/sb.

meaning: اختصاص دادن (وقت یا توجه) به چیزی

examples.english: I devote an hour a day to work.
examples.persian: روزی یک ساعت را به کار اختصاص می‌دهم.

miniContext: Devote sth to sth means to give an amount of time, attention, etc. to sth.

examples.english: The soldiers finally surrendered to the enemy.
examples.persian: سربازان بالاخره تسلیم دشمن شدند.

miniContext: Surrender means to admit you have been defeated and want to stop fighting.

examples.english: We'll confer with the minister about postponing the meeting.
examples.persian: درباره‌ی به‌تعویق‌انداختن جلسه با وزیر مشورت خواهیم کرد.

miniContext: Confer with sb means to discuss sth with sb in order to exchange opinions or get advice.

examples.english: The meeting coincides with the holiday.
examples.persian: جلسه با تعطیلات هم‌زمان است.

miniContext: Coincide with sth means (of two or more events) to take place at the same time.

meaning: مطابقت داشتن با، همخوانی داشتن با

examples.english: My account of the incident doesn't correspond with hers.
examples.persian: روایت من از این ماجرا با روایت او همخوانی ندارد.

miniContext: Correspond with sth means to be the same as or match sth.

examples.english: Children need to interact with other children.
examples.persian: بچه‌ها باید با بچه‌های دیگر تعامل داشته باشند.

miniContext: Interact with sb means to communicate with sb, especially when you are with them.

examples.english: We decided to proceed with the plan.
examples.persian: تصمیم گرفتیم با طرح ادامه دهیم.

miniContext: Proceed with sth means to continue doing sth that has already started.

meaning: آشتی دادن، سازگار کردن (دو چیز متضاد)

examples.english: It was hard to reconcile his career ambitions with the needs of his children.
examples.persian: سازگار کردن جاه‌طلبی‌های شغلی او با نیازهای فرزندانش سخت بود.

miniContext: Reconcile sth with sth means to find an acceptable way of dealing with two or more ideas, needs, etc. that seem to be opposed to each other.
